# Landing and README images

The landing page draws its maps live from generated data; the README shows a few of the same assets.

## Generated by the landing page's own tools

- `history-scrubber.json`: the page's one map stage. `tools/build_landing_history_scrubber.py` (`npm run build:landing-history-scrubber`) cuts the HOI4 1936 political features into pieces whose owner is fixed in HOI4 1936, HOI4 1939, TNO 1962 and Modern World, simplifies them as one coverage, and adds per-state borders, labels and names, the Atlantropa layers, Europe's railways (from `data/transport_layers/global_rail`) and major cities (from `data/world_cities.geojson`). Re-run after owner, colour or topology changes in those scenarios.
- `hgo-world.webp`, `hgo-europe.webp`, `hgo-zoom.json`: the HGO Atlas zoom. `tools/build_landing_hgo_zoom.py` (`npm run build:landing-hgo-zoom`) renders the committed HGO dataset exactly as HGO Atlas exports an unedited project with labels and cities off; it needs no browser. Re-run after the dataset in `apps/hgo/assets/default` changes.

## Other generated maps

- `hero-*.svg|webp|json`: Europe frames for each starting world, referenced by `sample-runs.json` and the sample banner in the editor. Rebuild with `npm run build:landing-hero-maps`; rasters come from `tools/rasterize_landing_assets.py`.
- `work-alt-history-med.*`, `work-scenario-switch-europe.*`, `work-atlas-japan-corridor.*`: overview maps used by the README and the sample manifest. Rebuild with `npm run build:landing-work-maps`. Their JSON companions record source paths, projection, bounds and selection policies.
- `japan-preview-*.svg|webp|json`: Japan transport, city, terrain and night views from `tools/build_landing_japan_preview.py`.

## Screenshots

- `product-workspace.webp` (README): captured on 2026-09-23 from the local editor at `/app/` with the TNO 1962 scenario, 3200 × 1800 at DPR 2. Appearance was adjusted in the editor; geometry and ownership were not retouched.
- `docs/readme/hgo-atlas.webp` (README): the HGO Atlas editor in English, 1600 × 900.
- `social-preview.svg|png`: the link-preview artwork.

HOI4 and TNO illustrations represent their game settings, including alternate-history geography. Geographic assets keep their dataset terms; consult the JSON companions and `data/source_ledger.json`.

Early `hero-workspace.webp` and `shot-*.webp` files in this directory are retired from the README and kept only so historical links still resolve.
